verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the prior approval. The implementation keeps Turtle serialization behind the opt-in Solid feature, negotiates solely from the requested media type before authorization or existence lookup, and renders both supported representations from the same gated triple extraction. The Turtle test exercises the real MCP tool path, requires syntax-specific prefix compaction, parses the result, and compares it with the default N-Triples representation; additional tests cover default compatibility, unsupported representations, existence non-disclosure, and refusal of binary writes. Documentation and the agent skill match the implemented public behavior. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-vacuity issue was found.
